integrity: All computations are supported by an included standalone exhaustive finite checker; all-k enumeration additionally has a mathematical proof. Originality is a best-knowledge literature assessment; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the explicitly defined 81-element commutative kei D(1); ordered tuples with repetitions. Free-four-generator status and order 81 were established in 2006. The full 1981 original monograph was not accessible, and equivalent unindexed generation results remain possible. The automorphism-group order, not group structure, is determined.
title: Exact generating-tuple laws and automorphism order of the 81-element free commutative kei
